item_title: Santos should consider resigning, veteran GOP lawmaker says
item_description: Hope Yen / Associated Press:  — Even as the House GOP leadership keeps silent, a veteran Republican lawmaker said Sunday that George Santos should consider resigning after the congressman-elect from New York admitted to lying about his heritage, education and professional career.
